name: nirvaana
description: Connects Claude Code to Nirvaana (https://nirvaana.ai/api/mcp) and, where the Nirvaana app runs on this Mac, to your own brain in ~/Nirvaana (brain_query, brain_add, brain_files): catch up at the start of a session, recall what Nirvaana keeps, search your own notes and files, and wrap up into your own world.
